author: replay-owner
question: On the frozen 441-day / 2.64 candidate trunk, does a zero-initialised multiplicative market-context head (arm C) improve the cross-sectional relative ranking over a parameter-matched scalar head on the same 80-dim representation (arm B)?
hypothesis: Same-timestamp cross-sectional information (mean / std / coverage of the pooled 80-dim stock representation) adds ranking information that a single stock's own representation and a scalar residual head cannot express, because the label is itself a same-timestamp cross-sectional z-score.

B.definition: one new scalar residual head on the 80-dim representation (parameter budget matched to C)

C.definition: ds = w^T (P h * G(m_t)), w zero-initialised, so step 0 equals the frozen prediction

primary_pair.why: The claim under test is that same-timestamp market context adds information beyond a parameter-matched scalar head; C - A and B - A are reported as context only.

windows.caliber: ten development months 2023-11 .. 2024-09 from configs/mktctx_replay_20261028_plan.json; all windows end before the sealed start; no window was used for training or selection

smoothing.note: same operator the published 441d@2.64 candidate uses

estimator.pairing: candidate daily rank_ic minus control daily rank_ic, paired within (window, trading day) and pooled across the ten windows (203 trading days); per-methyl-seed pairing when more than one seed exists

primary.method: whole-series 5-day moving-block bootstrap: ceil(n / 5) random-start wrap-around blocks concatenated to ceil(n / 5) * 5 days and averaged per replicate

secondary.role: reported side by side, never used as a gate
secondary.known_bias: one 5-day block mean per replicate; half width sqrt(n / 5) too wide, i.e. about 6.4x at 203 trading days

thresholds.note: unchanged from the pre-declared team criterion: point estimate >= +0.003, corrected moving-block CI excludes zero, and at least 7 of 10 windows positive

decision_rule.adopt: all three: pooled C - B point estimate >= +0.003, corrected 95% CI excludes zero, >= 7/10 windows positive
decision_rule.otherwise: record the null result, stop, and report; no threshold change and no re-running the same windows with a different seed
decision_rule.escalation: only after adopt: ask the captain to authorise extra seeds; the primary screen is seed 11

secondary_metrics.C_minus_A: descriptive, same pairing and both calibers; never the claim
secondary_metrics.B_minus_A: descriptive, same pairing and both calibers

turnover_delta.rule: report C - B and C - A turnover (eval-v2, U / 2)
turnover_delta.role: a degradation beyond the cap blocks adoption even if rank_ic passes

secondary_metrics.long_short_daily_mean: report for each arm and the paired difference

reference_gate.stop_rule: if the A arm does not reproduce on the five original windows, stop and report; do not continue burning replay time and do not adjust the caliber

host.required: ZBzdgJ / hz-4 (port 27794) /root/repo_featnorm only; hz-t3 has stale trunk code

ordering.note: at registration time no C-B, C-A or B-A rank_ic has been computed; the arm C and B weights are still training, and no replay of those versions exists

scope_limits: the screen is seed 11 only; multi-seed confirmation needs a separate captain authorisation
C - A and B - A are context, never the claim; the claim is the C - B increment
the corrected interval is the gate; the retired caliber is shown side by side only
no window at or after 2024-10-08 is read, and no window is used for training or selection
